lines.text: Happy New Year, little explorers! Time for a brand new adventure!
Leo made a giant list of one hundred huge New Year goals!
Learn to juggle, read fifty books, and build a giant treehouse!
Looking at the giant list made Leo feel nervous and completely stuck!
Then his wise teacher said, You don't have to climb the whole mountain today!
Just take one tiny, joyful step every single morning!
Read one page, practice one throw, and hammer one wooden board!
Tiny daily steps add up to giant superhero dreams!
Start your journey today and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
